title: God Executes Judgment

questions.question: We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks, for your name is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:1 (ESV): "We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks, for your name is near."

questions.question: At the set time that I appoint I will judge with what?
When the earth totters, and all its inhabitants, it is I who keep steady its what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:3 (ESV): "...it is I who keep steady its pillars."

questions.question: I say to the boastful, "Do not boast," and to the wicked, "Do not lift up your what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:4 (ESV): "...and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up your horn;'"

questions.question: Do not lift up your horn on high, or speak with what neck?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:5 (ESV): "do not lift up your horn on high, or speak with haughty neck."

questions.question: For not from the east or from the west and not from the wilderness comes what?
But it is God who executes judgment, putting down one and lifting up whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:7 (ESV): "...putting down one and lifting up another."

questions.question: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup with foaming wine, well what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:8 (ESV): "For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup with foaming wine, well mixed,"

questions.question: All the wicked of the earth shall drain it down to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:8 (ESV): "and he pours out from it, and all the wicked of the earth shall drain it down to the dregs."

questions.question: But I will declare it forever; I will sing praises to the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:9 (ESV): "...I will sing praises to the God of Jacob."

questions.question: All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous shall be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:10 (ESV): "...but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up."

questions.question: This Psalm is set to the tune of "Do Not what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 75 Title: "...according to Do Not Destroy. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song."

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 75?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75 Title: "...A Psalm of Asaph. A Song."

questions.question: Who keeps steady the pillars of the earth?
questions.explanation: Psalm 75:3 (ESV): "...it is I who keep steady its pillars."

key_verse_text: We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks, for your name is near. We recount your wondrous deeds.
